mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 200k signals stronger employment growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 1.2 million signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and drags on corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1.2 million for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST < 1.2m for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below 101 signals slowing manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings momentum and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 101 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO < 101 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month increase in the federal funds rate above 5.5% signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 5.5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures below $700 billion signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below $700 billion for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS < $700B for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and raises recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE < 3.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in GDP (GDPC1) below $22 trillion signals weakening macroeconomic demand, which reduces earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls below $22 trillion for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 < $22T for two quarters (t-test p > 0.05).
